messages:
nora: FYI starter sample failed on Node 18 after canary. dynamic import picked up CJS entry and crashed with "Cannot use import statement outside a module".

kai: can you paste the exports map?

nora: short snippet:
```json
"exports": {".":{"import":"./dist/esm/index.js","require":"./dist/cjs/index.js"}}
```

pack-bot: publish job used manifest-merge v2 which sorts keys alphabetically. This reorder can change Node conditional resolution order. log: https://ci.internal/pack/555

kai: ack. quick fix: revert canary, republish with stable writer that preserves conditional ordering and add CI unpack + assert on exports block. Also add a node-18 dynamic-import smoke test to samples.

nora: will do rollback + follow-up PR, and update onboarding checklist to include verifying sample dynamic imports on LTS nodes.
